definitions.explanation: Something that causes trouble or concern.

notes:
{頭痛|ずつう} refers to headaches, both literal and figurative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頭痛|ずつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have a headache)
- {頭痛|ずつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ (to have a terrible headache)
- {頭痛|ずつう}⟦{薬|やく}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (headache medicine)
- {頭痛|ずつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧ (source of headaches, cause for worry)
- ⟦{偏|へん}{頭痛|ずつう}→偏頭痛：25441_henzutsuu⟧ (migraine)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: my head hurts (describes the sensation)
- {頭痛|ずつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a headache (describes the condition)

OTHER BODY PAIN VOCABULARY:
- ⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧ (stomachache)
- ⟦{歯痛|しつう}→歯痛：noentry⟧ (toothache)
- ⟦{腰痛|ようつう}→腰痛：05020_youtsuu⟧ (back pain)
